name: mimo-v2.6-flash-tp2
description: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (309B/15B active, native MXFP4 experts + FP8 attention), TP2 across both Sparks, 300K context, fp8 KV.

source.title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL — TP2, 300K, fp8 KV
source.author: tonyd2wild (recipe + image), Plaaasma / MiaAI-Lab (alternatives)

measured.note: numbers include the bundled DFlash drafter (k=7); without it expect roughly half on code

requirements: Mod mimo-v26-tp2-fixes on both nodes: the four vLLM patches from the recipe repo (fused fp8 QKV loading for TP2, SupportsEagle3 marker, fp8 KV pass-through, drafter value scale) packaged as a mod with a run.sh that applies them — TP2 loads wrong weights without the QKV fix.
Weights XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (~178 GB) incl. the bundled dflash/ drafter directory (download_include).
Image ghcr.io/tonyd2wild/vllm-glm53-flash:sm121-v11-dflash2 (the same image as the GLM recipes).
notes: The checkpoint's generation_config sets max_new_tokens=2048, which cuts reasoning mid-thought; this profile overrides it (max_tokens 32768).
Near-greedy defaults make long tool sessions repeat the same call; repetition_penalty 1.05 is the recipe's fix.
To enable the bundled DFlash drafter (k=7), stage it as a loadable directory (see the eugr mimo-v2.6-flash mod) and add a speculative_config — measured ~2x on code.
Parser names qwen3 / qwen3_xml follow the upstream MiMo vLLM recipe; users of this image report its tool parser truncating some string arguments — see the recipe thread before relying on tool calls.
